jobs.title: Senior / Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).




YOUR ROLE

We’re hiring a Senior or Principal Product Manager (experience dependent) to build and own the growth of one of Zip's product verticals. In this role, you will lead the teams operating at the frontiers of Zip as we expand into new segments and use cases. You will ensure that we continue to deliver a consumer-grade collaboration experience while supporting complex cross-functional workflows. 




YOU WILL

 - Drive the strategy and execution for expanding Zip into new markets, verticals, and product categories.

 - Identify, validate, and launch new high-impact use cases that unlock growth opportunities.

 - Develop and test hypotheses through rapid experimentation, customer research, and market analysis.

 - Balance speed and scalability, ensuring new initiatives can evolve into durable, enterprise-ready product offerings.

 - Align the GTM, enablement, and sales strategies with our product strategy to drive the business success of new offerings 

 - Foster strong relationships with customers to ensure product alignment with user needs 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4 - 8+ years of Product Management experience

 - Experience scaling SaaS products in a high-growth environment. Additional experience building products from 0-to-1 preferred

 - Extreme attention to detail and ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

 - Strong written and oral communication with internal and external stakeholders

 - Ability to prioritize ruthlessly, even if it may disappoint customers or stakeholders

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $280,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈  Start-up equity

 - 🦷  Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️  Catered lunches & dinners for SF employees

 - 🚍  Commuter benefit

 - 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴  Flexible PTO

 - 💻  Apple equipment plus home office budget

 - 💸  401k plan



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

 - Partner with Documentation and Education teams to embed AI-native guidance directly into the product experience – including dynamic “Getting Started” flows, troubleshooting assistance, and contextual recommendations.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2-4+ years of product management and 4-8+ years of overall professional experience; experience working on SaaS onboarding, activation or platform tooling is a plus.

 - Ability to break down ambiguous operational and configuration challenges into structured systems and scalable solutions.

 - Demonstrated comfort owning operationally intensive product areas – including migrations, versioning, enablement workflows, and cross-functional coordination – and turning repetitive processes into scalable frameworks.

 - Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across product, engineering, design, sales, customer success, and documentation teams, influencing without authority.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort defining measurable adoption and growth metrics.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

YOUR ROLE

As a Principal Product Manager on the Payments team, you will own the systems and strategy that power Zip's global payments infrastructure and make Zip the safest and most seamless way to pay vendors across tens of billions in annual spend. You will drive product development across the payments platform -- including bank integrations, payment provider partnerships, payout management, and payment routing -- as well as payment controls covering risk and fraud prevention, bank account verification, payment onboarding, currency management, and payment compliance. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Payment Operations, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable payment infrastructure, proactively mitigate payment fraud, ensure smooth and secure payment onboarding, and manage payment compliance with confidence at enterprise scale.




YOU WILL

 - Own the payments platform strategy and roadmap, including direct bank integrations, payment provider partnerships, and payment routing infrastructure that supports tens of billions in annual volume across 40+ currencies and 130+ countries

 - Drive the product strategy and roadmap to reduce payment risk -- including Zip's AI-powered fraud detection system that flags risky invoices directly to customers

 - Own bank account verification– expanding provider coverage, increasing geographic reach, and ensuring reliable real-time verification across customer segments.

 - Lead payments onboarding automation – building customer-facing workflows that reduce manual operational overhead and accelerate go-live.

 - Define product strategy for payment method management to help buyers and vendors transact seamlessly, including multi-provider support and payout group management.

 - Lead payments platform modernization -- expanding payment rails and payout capabilities, improving payment cycle times, and ensuring enterprise-grade reliability at scale.

 - Drive currency localization across Zip – enabling customers to support multi-currency workflows across all payment surfaces.

 - Collaborate deeply with engineering and design to define requirements, provide product direction, make tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality, enterprise-grade payment capabilities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of product management and 10+ years of overall professional experience; experience working on payments infrastructure, fintech, bank integrations, risk/fraud, or financial compliance is a requirement.

 - Ability to break down complex payment and risk problems into structured components and deliver clear product recommendations.

 - Technical fluency with the ability to partner effectively with engineering on integration architectures, API design, payment processing systems, and data-driven risk systems.

 - Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, and drive alignment across engineering, design, operations, and customer-facing teams.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to drive product decisions, measure fraud metrics, and evaluate risk model performance.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Bias to action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

We’re hiring a Senior/Principal Product Manager (experience dependent) to lead a core part of Zip’s AI Agent product, one of the company’s fastest-moving and most strategic bets. Zip recently launched Superagents: LLM-powered teammates that take on the repetitive, low-value work drowning procurement, AP, risk, and legal teams so those teams can focus on strategic work.



As PM, you’ll own the vision and strategy for a major area of this product and drive it end to end with a high degree of autonomy. And because businesses trust these agents to act on their behalf, you’ll own the quality bar that makes that trust possible: the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that keep agent output accurate, auditable, and reliable.

 - Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for a major area of Zip’s AI product, translating a fast-changing technology landscape into a clear, opinionated view on what to build and why

 - Own the quality bar for AI experiences end to end, designing the evals, rollout gates, guardrails, and feedback loops that let customers trust agents to act on their behalf, and holding the line on accuracy and reliability even as capabilities expand

 - Roll up your sleeves wherever the team needs it, whether that’s sitting in on user research, debugging a quality issue, or reviewing agent outputs




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in SaaS or consumer tech, with a track record of owning ambiguous, high-impact areas end to end

 - Deep experience partnering with engineering and design to ship sophisticated products with a great user experience

 - Experience building platform or foundational products that other teams build on top of, with a collaborative, service-oriented approach to aligning roadmaps and making their success your own

 - A track record of setting product strategy and influencing cross-functional partners and leadership without direct authority

 - Strong written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives

 - Extreme attention to detail, with the ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

jobs.description:

YOUR ROLE 

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own and operate the core programs that enable Engineering to move fast, improve quality, and deliver consistently. This includes running our Managed Release Process, overseeing technical quality OKR (e.g. bugs, performance, and incident follow-ups), and driving horizontal project coordination across EPD.

You’ll work closely with engineers to build operational muscle, drive issue resolution, and make sure our processes scale as we do. This is a highly technical, execution-focused role—ideal for someone with strong systems thinking, process orientation, and just enough engineering fluency to collaborate with our developers.

As we scale, velocity, reliability, and quality become increasingly interdependent. This role ensures we don’t just build fast—we build with confidence. You’ll be a key player in the infrastructure that supports Engineering success across the company.




YOU WILL

 - Lead the Managed Release Process: Coordinate our monthly feature release program—tracking feature flags, aligning engineering launch timelines, and ensuring Product Marketing and Customer Enablement are prepared for customer-facing updates.

 - Feature Flag Hygiene: Drive process improvements for the lifecycle of feature flags (creation, usage, and cleanup).

 - Incident & Bug Management: Own follow-up processes for engineering incidents, top bugs, and associated corrective actions. Drive retrospectives, identify patterns, and ensure issues are consistently closed out.

 - Performance Regression Follow-up: Track regressions, escalate where needed, and coordinate owners to resolve issues promptly.

 - Cross-Team Engineering Dependencies: Understand enough about our architecture and workflows to help teams unblock and align on timing, ownership, and integration needs.

 - Vendor Oversight: Manage operational tasks related to select technical vendors, including usage forecasting, access management, renewals, and credit tracking.




QUALIFICATIONS 

 - 1-3 years in Technical Program Management, Engineering Operations, Product Operations, or a similar role at a fast-paced technology company.

 - Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent.

 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, continuous integration practices, incident management, and deployment/release management.

 - Familiarity with concepts like feature flags, incidents, and bug ticket lifecycles: you don’t need to write code, but you should be fluent enough to follow the conversation.

 - Ability to drive clarity and accountability in cross-functional environments, including defining success metrics and reporting on them.

 - Process-oriented mindset with the curiosity to spot gaps and the grit to close them.

 - Familiarity with vendor management and usage forecasting.

 - Experience working across product infrastructure and application-level teams.

 - Familiarity with tools like Linear, Zendesk, Notion, Snowflake, and GitHub to manage workflows and document processes.

 - Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Cowork to automate routine workflows.

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).




YOUR ROLE

We're hiring a Senior/Principal Product Manager (experience dependent) to lead Zip's Contract Orchestration product, one of the company's newest and most strategic bets. Buy-side contracting is still broken: reviews and redlines live in email threads, signed agreements disappear into shared drives, and requesters call the process a black box. Zip's customers execute over a million contract reviews a year and most of them are routine agreements. We just launched AI Contract Orchestration to take that work off legal and procurement, and there is far more to build.


You'll own the vision and strategy for one or more areas of this product, end to end and with a high degree of autonomy. The category is established, but Zip has an edge: as the front door for procurement, we see every contract with clean intake data on the requester, spend, category, and risk, so our AI can review clauses, propose redlines, and route work on real context rather than the document alone. As PM, you'll balance different users' interests throughout the contracting process (procurement, legal, finance, requesters, suppliers), and you'll own the quality bar that lets legal trust AI with language that carries real liability.




YOU WILL

 - Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for Contract Orchestration, with a clear, opinionated view of where we beat incumbent CLMs

 - Ship AI that does the work: clause analysis, playbook-grounded redlines, contract generation, triage and routing, and metadata extraction accurate enough to trust

 - Own the full lifecycle, from intake and negotiation to the repository, contract families, renewals, and contract-to-spend compliance

 - Work directly with customers to ship features that reduce contract cycle times and increase contract visibility and compliance

 - Build agents and own the AI quality bar end to end: evals, guardrails, and feedback loops

 - Roll up your sleeves wherever the team needs it, from user research to reviewing extraction quality on a customer's contracts




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4 - 8+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, owning ambiguous, high-impact areas end to end

 - Deep experience partnering with engineering and design to ship sophisticated products with a great user experience

 - Experience with workflow or document-heavy enterprise products

 - A track record of setting product strategy and influencing cross-functional partners and leadership without direct authority

 - Experience shipping AI or ML features where accuracy is non-negotiable, including how you measured and improved quality

 - Strong written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives

 - Extreme attention to detail, with the ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

 - Ability to prioritize ruthlessly, even if it may disappoint customers or stakeholders



The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $280,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.




PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈  Start-up equity

 - 🦷  Full health, vision & dental coverage

 - 🍽️  Catered lunches & dinners for SF employees

 - 🚍  Commuter benefit

 - 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

 - 🌴  Flexible PTO

 - 💻  Apple equipment plus home office budget

 - 💸  401k plan



We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

As a Product Operations Manager for strategic programs, you will help lead our most important cross-functional product programs, including company-critical launches and large-scale customer rollouts, while owning the operating cadence for roadmap, planning and launch enablement. You will work cross-functionally to establish clear plans, align teams, surface risks, and drive decisions.

This is not a status-tracking role: you will bring operational leadership needed to move complex, high-stakes initiatives from strategy through launch, adoption, and measurable outcomes. Equally, you will build the lightweight, durable systems and ways of working that let the product organization operate effectively as it scales – the operating cadence is yours to design and own, not just to run.




YOU WILL

 - Lead the end-to-end execution of the company’s highest-priority product programs, from initial alignment through launch, rollout, and post-launch follow-through.

 - Build integrated program plans that clarify scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decision points, success measures, and escalation paths.

 - Own the annual, half-year, and quarterly product planning cadence in partnership with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership.

 - Maintain a coherent, current view of the product roadmap across teams, including company priorities, major commitments, capacity constraints, sequencing, and cross-team dependencies.

 - Create effective forums for strategy reviews, roadmap decisions, launch reviews, executive updates, and retrospectives.

 - Close the loop between execution and improvement – capture what launches and planning cycles teach us, and turn it into better defaults for the next one.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4-8+ years of experience in product operations, technical program management, product management, business operations, or a related role within a technology company.

 - Demonstrated success leading complex, high-stakes, cross-functional product launches or multi-quarter programs from strategy through rollout and adoption.

 - Experience designing or running roadmap, prioritization, and planning cadences across multiple product and engineering teams.

 - A track record of building repeatable systems and ways of working – not just executing within existing ones.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, including experience delivering concise, decision-ready updates to executives and senior stakeholders.

 - Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, complex customer implementations, migrations, or phased product rollouts is preferred.

The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $230,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager who will be responsible for building out Zip’s competitive strategy and market intelligence program. The ideal candidate for this position is a strategic thinker with a deep passion for market research, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate competitive insights into actionable strategies. You’re someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, can operate without a set playbook, and excels at distilling complex information into clear, compelling messaging.

As a strategic cross-functional partner, you’ll drive competitive enablement across our go-to-market, product, and executive teams. Example initiatives include developing competitive playbooks and battle cards, tracking market trends and competitive moves, delivering training to sales teams, and partnering with product managers to inform roadmap decisions based on competitive dynamics.

Please note that we are looking for someone who will be able to come into our downtown San Francisco or NYC office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).




YOU WILL

 - Own Zip’s competitive intelligence strategy and conduct in-depth research on market trends, competitive offerings, and emerging threats to inform Zip’s positioning and GTM approach

 - Develop and maintain competitive analysis materials (e.g., battlecards, competitive briefs, objection-handling guides, etc.) to equip sales and customer-facing teams with the insights they need to win

 - Deliver ongoing training and enablement sessions for sales, customer success, and other teams to ensure they have a deep understanding of Zip’s competitive advantages

 - Collaborate with product managers to provide competitive insights that shape roadmap decisions, feature prioritization, and differentiation strategies

 - Partner within the marketing and analyst relations team to ensure Zip is well-represented in thought leadership content and industry reports

 - Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform GTM strategy, marketing campaigns, and sales plays

 - Stay ahead of industry trends and procurement technology innovations to ensure Zip remains the clear leader in intake and procurement orchestration




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of experience in product marketing, competitive intelligence, market research, or a related field

 - Experience extracting insights from data, articulating findings, and influencing stakeholders on strategic proposals

 - Strong project management skills to plan and execute multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines

 - Foundational product marketing skills (messaging & positioning, GTM strategy, audience segmentation, sales enablement, content creation, market research, etc.)

 - Proven track record of building and maintaining strong relationships with sales, product management, and other cross-functional teams

 - Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills (written, verbal, and visual)

 - An ability to work both independently and collaboratively

 - Bachelor's degree or higher in a related field of study




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience and/or domain knowledge in the B2B procurement, finance, or workflow management space
